sideA.text: Draw and read the other side of this card.

sideB.text:
DESTROY THE FOLLOWING OBJECTIVE:
• RECON 1 UNKNOWN REGION

The "Recon East Asia" objective is enclosed. If you have already Reconned East Asia, count this objective as complete during September!

RIGHT NOW!
Open the following doors:
R    55    D    Y    U

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the September setup Legacy-deck reading, immediately after 09-02. Side A says to read side B now.
rules: Destroy the objective RECON 1 UNKNOWN REGION.
The Recon East Asia objective is enclosed (09-04, the next card). If East Asia has already been reconned, count that objective complete during September.
Immediately open doors R, 55, D, Y, and U.
mechanics.notes: The five door badges are R, 55, D, Y, and U, in that order. R, D, Y, and U are letters. 55 is a number. What is inside them is not printed on this card.
